questions.question_text: In which year did Pakistan become an independent nation?
questions.explanation: Pakistan gained its independence from British rule on August 14, 1947.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Governor-General of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Muhammad Ali Jinnah served as the first Governor-General of Pakistan from independence until his death.

questions.question_text: In which city was the All India Muslim League founded in 1906?
questions.explanation: The All India Muslim League was established in Dhaka, British India, in 1906.

questions.question_text: What is the national flower of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Jasmine (Chambeli) is recognized as the national flower of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Who gave the famous address at Allahabad in 1930?
questions.explanation: Allama Iqbal delivered the historic Allahabad Address in 1930, proposing a separate state for Muslims.

questions.question_text: The Indus Water Treaty was signed between Pakistan and which country?
questions.explanation: The Indus Water Treaty was signed in 1960 between Pakistan and India regarding the distribution of river waters.

questions.question_text: In which calendar year did Pakistan achieve independence?
questions.explanation: Pakistan became a sovereign nation on August 14, 1947.

questions.question_text: Who served as the first Governor-General of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah was the first Governor-General.

questions.question_text: In which city was the All India Muslim League established in 1906?
questions.explanation: The Muslim League was formed in Dhaka, then part of British India.

questions.question_text: What is the official national flower of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Jasmine (Chambeli) is the recognized national flower of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Who delivered the historical presidential address at Allahabad in 1930?
questions.explanation: Allama Iqbal presented the vision of a separate Muslim state in his 1930 address.

questions.question_text: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed between Pakistan and which neighbor?
questions.explanation: The treaty was brokered by the World Bank between Pakistan and India in 1960.
